title: State Farm Fire & Casualty Co. v. Tashire (1967)
summary: Interpleader could protect the policy fund, but it could not become a device for controlling the entire accident litigation.
notes: Rule 22 interpleader has different jurisdictional prerequisites. Do not transfer § 1335’s minimal-diversity and service rules to Rule 22 without analysis.

sections.Parties: State Farm, the truck driver’s insurer, sought interpleader against persons claiming injuries from a bus-truck collision.
sections.Material Facts: The collision in California killed two people and injured many others. Claimants lived in different states and countries. The policy provided a small fund in relation to the asserted damages. The insurer sought relief broad enough to prevent related litigation against its insured and other participants, not merely inconsistent recovery from the policy proceeds.
sections.Procedural History: The lower court granted broad injunctive relief. The Supreme Court recognized the availability of statutory interpleader but rejected the breadth of the restraint on other litigation.
sections.Issue: Could an insurer’s limited-fund interpleader prevent all tort suits arising from the accident?
sections.Holding: No. Interpleader could protect the fund, but could not sweep in the entire controversy on that basis.
sections.Reasoning: The Court accepted minimal diversity among claimants as constitutionally sufficient for the interpleader statute and did not require claims already reduced to judgment. It then separated jurisdiction over competing demands for the fund from authority to restrict claims against other assets or defendants. The policy limit gave the insurer a legitimate stakeholder interest, but not a power to make all accident litigation revolve around that comparatively small fund. The scope of the remedy had to fit the jurisdictional and protective purpose.

learning.why: Interpleader could protect the policy fund, but it could not become a device for controlling the entire accident litigation.

topics.cp-statutory-interpleader: Minimal diversity and potential claims supported statutory interpleader of the insurance fund.
topics.cp-interpleader: Protection of a limited fund did not justify barring all related tort litigation.
topics.cp-diversity: The decision illustrates the difference between Article III’s allowance and the complete-diversity rule under the ordinary statute.

learning.separateOpinions: Justice Douglas dissented from allowing the pre-judgment interpleader in the circumstances.

mnemonic.rationale: A bus, a truck, and an interpleader
